name: Zikkit's Tunnelpack
inspire: After an Action step, if a friendly fighter was dealt damage or slain in that step, pick one other friendly fighter. Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: More-more Power!
reactions.trigger: Use this immediately at the start of your Action step if each friendly fighter has a Charge token.
reactions.flavorText: The Skaven of Zikkit's Tunnelpack push the limits of their creations with the twisted science of the Clans Skryre.
reactions.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter. Remove that fighter's Move and/or Charge tokens. After that Action step, roll an Attack dice. On a {icon:hammer} or {icon:crit}, that fighter is slain.

abilities.name: Skitter
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after your Action step.
abilities.flavorText: Skaven are infamously twitchy, paranoid, aggressive and rarely around in one spot for too long.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter with no Move or Charge tokens. That fighter Moves. This ability can only be used once per game.

abilities.name: Warp-charged
abilities.trigger: Use this ability immediately after you pick a weapon as part of an Attack.
abilities.flavorText: The Clans Skryre craft weapons renowned for lethality and unpredictability in equal measure.
abilities.rulesText: Inflict 1 damage on the attacker. That weapon has Cleave ({icon:cleave}), Ensnare ({icon:ensnare}) and Brutal ({icon:brutal}) for that Attack. This ability can only be used once per game.

abilities.name: Kaboom!
abilities.flavorText: A rat with a bomb... simple, yet effective.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly minion ({icon:minion}) with no Charge tokens to use this ability. That minion Moves. Then, roll a number of Attack dice equal to the battle round number for each fighter within 2 hexes of that minion. If the roll contains any {icon:hammer}, inflict 1 damage on that fighter. If the roll contains any {icon:crit}, inflict 2 damage on that fighter instead. Then, that minion is slain.

playstyle: Five fragile Skryre skaven with modest health and dodge saves, relying on steady Move 4 and a once-per-game Skitter reposition rather than resilience. Their volatile tech hurts themselves as much as foes: Warp-charged weapons damage the wielder in exchange for Cleave, Ensnare and Brutal, while Tik Tik can scurry in and detonate, its Kaboom growing deadlier each round. Every wound or death among the pack inspires another fighter, so the warband wins by recklessly spending health and bodies to power up its survivors and overwhelm key targets.
